documentation.content: The hourly redraw of the owner board failed (`board_redraw_failed`), or it refused to write because the board bucket is missing or not private (`board_bucket_public`, with a `reason`). The board at storage.cloud.google.com/bestbefore-f9ee1-owner-board/board.html is then stale. See functions/README.md, "The board" > "Always on" and "Logs to alert on".
